expected_symptom: dxc terminates with an internal compiler failure (assert / access violation) on an invalid shader, emitting no diagnostic
history: always-repro'd across v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 (all 20 releases probed linearly, no invalid probes). v1.4.1907 (2019-07) and v1.5.2010 (2020-10) both predate the 2021-04-19 report and both crash, so this covers the issue's whole life. Not an NDEBUG artefact: the releases are NDEBUG builds and they access-violate, and gh-ing past the assert locally reaches the same fault.
summary: Still crashes on main (1.9.0.5433, ab5400907) and on all 20 bisectable releases measured from v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607: Debug asserts on a null pointer in DxilLowerCreateHandleForLib (0xE0000001), all 20 access-violate (0xC0000005), and v1.4.1907/v1.5.2010 crash with no output at all. Minimised to 10 lines; the trigger named in the body -- assigning one global RWTexture2D to another -- is diagnosed rather than crashed, and the 10-line crashing reduction uses a round trip through a resource-returning function back into the same global. hlsl_clang_trunk rejects the same source with a located diagnostic.
title: DXC Crash on Bad Shader
